1 WHEEL AND AXLE 110 Se t FOR COAL TUB SIZE: 6 FT X 3 FT X 2.25 FT (One set consists of 2 Nos Wheel and 1 No. Axle) Coal Tub Wheel & Axles are required for Transportation of coal in Un der Ground Coal Mines.: Conformity to Drawing No. CE(E&M)/001 (Copy Attached) Compliance to IS:4001-1995 Or Latest Amendment if any Critical dimensions of Wheel: a) Wheel diameter on tread: 305 mm. b) Flange diameter: 346 mm. c) Tread thickness :10 mm (min.) d) Tread taper.: 1 in 20. e) Effective tread width: 70 mm. f) Axle diameter: 50 mm (min.) g) Out of straightness of any Axle: 1.6 mm (max.) h) Distance between wheel collars: 560mm. i) Distance between wheel bases when fitted on axle: 554 mm. j) Materials of wheels: Cast steel, Gr.01, IS:1030 (Latest) Suitably heat treated to render the wheels tough. All casting shall be free from: Cracks, Cold shots, Sponginess, Sand inclusion s, Injurious defects. Defects are not built up by welding or by any kind of putty. AXLE. Steel conforming to Class 4 of IS:1875-1992. Free from: Serrations flaws, Dent marks. Axle ends neatly sawn & press fitted to IS:2709- 1982 with the wheels. The maximum departure from straightness of any Axle shall not exceed 1.6 mm, when measured from flat surface. Weight of one set of wheels and axle should be 47 Kg +/- 2% Note: Test Certificate shall be submitted with the Supply of material. 1.
